name: Automatically localize official updates
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 1 * * *' # 09:17 Asia/Shanghai; GitHub may delay scheduled jobs
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      verify_existing:
        description: Rebuild/test the current release even when already published (no overwrite)
        type: boolean
        default: false
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/auto-update.yml'
      - 'tools/**'
      - 'tests/test_auto_update.py'
      - 'tests/auto-windows-smoke.ps1'
      - 'translations/**'
      - 'upstream/auto-compatibility.json'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: private-localization-releases
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      statuses: write
    outputs:
      build: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.build }}
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      PYTHONUTF8: '1'
      VERIFY_EXISTING: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.verify_existing == true }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: python tools/auto_update.py status --state pending
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_auto_update.py -v
      - name: Discover and build the official latest
        id: prepare
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=()
          if [[ "$VERIFY_EXISTING" == "true" ]]; then args+=(--verify-existing); fi
          python tools/auto_update.py prepare "${args[@]}"
      - name: Preserve discovery and candidate diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: automatic-candidate
          path: automation/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30
  windows:
    needs: check
    if: needs.check.outputs.build == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: automatic-candidate
          path: automation
      - name: Check actual candidate process and Chinese menus
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./tests/auto-windows-smoke.ps1 -Root automation/smoke -Output automation/runtime.json
      - name: Preserve runtime evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: automatic-windows-runtime
          path: automation/runtime.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30
  publish:
    needs: [check, windows]
    if: needs.check.outputs.build == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      PYTHONUTF8: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: automatic-candidate
          path: automation
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: automatic-windows-runtime
          path: automation
      - name: Record tested pins and publish only a new release
        run: python tools/auto_update.py finalize
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: automatic-publication-receipt
          path: automation/published.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 90
  report:
    if: always()
    needs: [check, windows, publish]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      statuses: write
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      CHECK: ${{ needs.check.result }}
      WINDOWS: ${{ needs.windows.result }}
      PUBLISH: ${{ needs.publish.result }}
      BUILD: ${{ needs.check.outputs.build }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Report pipeline outcome
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ "$CHECK" == "success" && ( "$BUILD" != "true" || ( "$WINDOWS" == "success" && "$PUBLISH" == "success" ) ) ]]; then
            python tools/auto_update.py status --state success --description 'Official latest checked; any candidate passed all publication gates'
          else
            python tools/auto_update.py status --state failure --description 'Automatic localization blocked; inspect logs and diagnostic artifacts'
            exit 1
          fi
